title: UKPC judgment metadata
description: Judicial Committee of the Privy Council appeals from Hong Kong. Comes through HKLII's /api/getother (hopt-C category), not /api/getjudgment, so ukpc.py:save_ukpc_local writes a distinct metadata shape from the 12 mainline court/tribunal slugs. On disk at output/ukpc/{year}/ukpc_{year}_{num}.json — sits in a court directory but uses this schema, not case-metadata.schema.json. Sibling .html and .txt files exist for every row (237 triplets on disk); they are HKLII-served body files and have no schema (raw HTML / plain text), analogous to the .html/.txt siblings on mainline case rows.

abbr.description: Court slug — always 'ukpc' on this shape.

lang.description: Lowercase in the metadata (contrast with UKPC's HKLII listing endpoint which uses uppercase EN/TC).
